In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Virgo cluster is an HI deficient cluster, but the deficiency is not as severe as that previously thought.
the Virgo cluster is a complex, dynamic system of interacting galaxies with a substantial amount of diffuse gas.
Virgo is a complex system of interacting galaxies, and the HI data presented here are a valuable addition to the body of evidence supporting this view.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HI mass distribution is consistent with the optical distribution, but that the HI mass fraction of the total mass is lower than the optical fraction.
the median distance for our catalog of HI detections is ~16.5 Mpc, with 95% of the sources having distances <22 Mpc.
the HI mass distribution is consistent with the Virgo Cluster Catalog and Virgo Cluster Catalog Extension.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the distribution of HI in the Virgo cluster is dominated by the Virgo spiral population.
the HI mass function is not significantly different from that found in the field and that the Virgo cluster is unlikely to have had a significant impact on the HI mass function in this region.
